scope: Inventory reconciliation snapshot for the Flutter UI/UX audit
method: Current source and fixture-path checks; not exhaustive component or visual coverage certification

router.boundary: Unauthenticated meeting redirects are tested in the production-router fixture. Authenticated meeting route builders are not mounted there; meeting screens use isolated local fakes. Production-router /missing/private-path is treated as the matched /project/:projectId missing-project state, while isolated GoRouter tests verify unmatched-route recovery.

surfaceCoverageNotes.coverage: 19 local widget tests covering Canvas host behaviors including GLB preview scaling, selected Model3D top-center resize and header drag, shape labels, connector endpoint/waypoint/elbow editing, Escape cancellation, and label drag. Connector and resize-handle gesture fixtures explicitly hide compact panels so the scrim does not intercept pointer input; the resize_handles_test.dart suite passes four tests.
surfaceCoverageNotes.verification: flutter test --no-pub --concurrency=1 test/features/canvas/canvas_editor_surface_preview_test.dart, test/features/canvas/resize_handles_test.dart, and test/features/model3d/model3d_node_widget_test.dart passed serially on 2026-10-05; scoped flutter analyze reported no issues for three changed Dart targets.

surfaceCoverageNotes.coverage: Connector test fixtures hide Layers and Inspector with CanvasEditorPanelController so the compact-panel scrim does not intercept pointer events. Production behavior was not changed as part of that fixture correction.

candidates.control: Canvas resize/vector/drawing selection handles use an 8 px screen-space hit radius; selection handles are canvas manipulation affordances rather than conventional standalone buttons.
candidates.verificationGap: Tests exercise handle detection, not touch-target geometry or small-screen touch ergonomics.

candidates.control: Canvas document-title rename is an opaque GestureDetector with a 44 px minimum-height pointer target; the text visual remains natural height.
candidates.verificationGap: The composed title target and layout exceptions are asserted at 320/390/800/1280/1439/1440 px, covering both sides of the breadcrumb's wide-breakpoint transition. Browser/device rendering is not covered.

candidates.control: Model3D drag header has an opaque 44 px target while retaining the 14 px icon/label content; tap, drag, keyboard selection and semantic bounds are covered in the local node fixture.
candidates.verificationGap: Local widget evidence covers target geometry, lower-edge tap, drag callback, keyboard Enter and accessibility semantics; browser/device visual and screen-reader validation remain open.

candidates.control: In threeDAndTwoD mode the live preview is fitted into half of the node viewport, but the control dock is a sibling overlay outside that FittedBox.
candidates.verificationGap: The proposed dock-scaling defect is not supported by current source. Keep the standalone 44x44 control assertion; verify only if a future layout change nests the dock in the fitted preview.

candidates.control: PDF page jump and zoom reset have 45 px minimum-height opaque hit targets around their existing compact bordered visuals; the toolbar is horizontally scrollable.
candidates.verificationGap: Focused geometry and page-jump interaction test passes at 320/390/800/1280 px with a local ProviderScope. The 320 px header uses a compact actions menu; visual/browser-device validation and other PDF loading/error states remain outside this fixture.

candidates.control: Selected link-card URL label/edit is an opaque minimum 44 px pointer target; compact cards under 128 px height reflow actions into a menu alongside the URL control.
candidates.verificationGap: Geometry and in-place edit targets are asserted at 320x220, 180x120, 120x100 and 120x80. The compact fixtures pass without layout exceptions; browser/device and accessibility-mode coverage remain open.
